narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. That threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Fixed at [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6), old name still works.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Fixed at [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

Exit `0`. Still 8 warnings, all deprecation notices.

Next: clear the `DEP0198` `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher` uses if you want zero warnings.
